title: Pell Shelving
tagline: An open oak bookcase that grows with you

content.text: Pell is built from solid oak uprights and shelves that slot together without a single screw. Start with one unit and add more as your collection of books, records and ceramics grows.
The shelves are thick enough to carry the heaviest art books without sagging.

care: Wipe with a soft, damp cloth and dry straight away. Re-oil once or twice a year with the care kit included.
